project.name: griTTYkit
project.scope: griTTYkit-maintained source code, scripts, tests, and documentation unless a file states a different license

compatibility.summary: The default integrated stack is GPLv2-compatible: griTTYkit is GPL-2.0-or-later, BusyBox is GPL-2.0, Buildroot is GPL-2.0-or-later with package exceptions, doom-ascii is GPL-2.0-or-later, and miniz is permissive.

sources.name: BusyBox
sources.note: Official BusyBox license page identifies BusyBox as GNU GPL version 2.

sources.name: Buildroot
sources.note: Official Buildroot manual describes Buildroot itself as GPL version 2 or later, with package patch exceptions.

sources.name: doom-ascii
sources.note: Upstream project metadata and pinned source lock identify doom-ascii as GPLv2-compatible.

sources.name: miniz
sources.note: Vendored upstream license file records permissive MIT or Unlicense terms.

whole_project_assessment.summary: GPL-2.0-or-later is appropriate for griTTYkit-maintained repository content and GPLv2-compatible combined artifacts using the current default stack.
whole_project_assessment.caveat: Buildroot can select packages under many upstream licenses; each newly bundled payload package must be reviewed, pinned, and represented in this policy before distribution.

artifact_distribution.buildroot_role: build-system; selected packages keep their own licenses
artifact_distribution.payload_license_rule: release artifacts must preserve the license and source obligations of every bundled payload component
artifact_distribution.user_supplied_data_rule: user-provided data such as Doom WAD files is not bundled by griTTYkit and is outside the griTTYkit project license grant

corresponding_source_strategy.summary: Redistributed binaries should be accompanied by corresponding source or a compliant written offer for griTTYkit-maintained code, BusyBox, and every bundled GPL payload component.
source_reconstruction_inputs: this repository at the recorded release commit
Buildroot-generated package source manifests when optional payload packages are selected

components.name: griTTYkit
distribution_obligations: Preserve LICENSE.grit, LICENSE, NOTICE, and griTTYkit source availability for redistributed griTTYkit code.

components.name: BusyBox
components.compatibility: GPLv2-compatible combined distribution; griTTYkit dispatches to BusyBox and is not a BusyBox fork
distribution_obligations: Preserve BusyBox GPLv2 notices and source availability when distributing artifacts that include the BusyBox payload.

components.name: Buildroot
components.compatibility: Compatible build system; payload packages keep their own licenses and notice/source obligations
distribution_obligations: Preserve Buildroot notices/source metadata for redistributed build-system source archives.
Audit licenses of selected Buildroot payload packages separately; Buildroot package exceptions do not relicense those payloads.

components.name: doom-ascii
components.compatibility: GPLv2-compatible optional payload engine; game WAD data is user-provided and not bundled
distribution_obligations: Preserve doom-ascii GPL notices and source availability when distributing artifacts that include the optional engine.
Do not bundle Doom WAD data unless its separate license permits redistribution.

components.name: miniz
components.compatibility: Permissive license compatible with GPL distribution when notices are preserved
distribution_obligations: Preserve the vendored miniz license notice when distributing source or binaries that include miniz-derived code.

components.name: prompt-toolkit
components.compatibility: Permissive BSD-style operator-side dependency compatible with GPL distribution when notices are preserved
distribution_obligations: Preserve prompt-toolkit license notices when redistributing the pinned source archive or an offline operator tooling bundle.

components.name: wcwidth
components.compatibility: Permissive operator-side dependency compatible with GPL distribution when notices are preserved
distribution_obligations: Preserve wcwidth license notices when redistributing the pinned source archive or an offline operator tooling bundle.

distribution_guidance: Keep LICENSE.grit, LICENSE, NOTICE, and LICENSES/ with release bundles.
Keep manifests/sources.lock.json pinned for downloaded source archives; release bundles include it as both sources.lock.json and manifests/sources.lock.json.
Preserve third-party notices in third_party/ and LICENSES/.
Treat Buildroot-selected packages as separately licensed payload components.
Do not add a network-fetched component without pinned version, URL, SHA-256, filename, license, and homepage metadata.
